patterns.condition: A UI element needs a flat shape, border or gradient
patterns.action: Use a material instance of a UI shape material (domain User Interface) as the widget fill instead of an imported texture
patterns.statement: Epic's UI material instances replace textures for flat shapes

patterns.condition: UI shapes need hover, focus, press or disabled looks
patterns.action: Use the instance state parameters of the UI shape material for each interaction state
patterns.statement: Epic's UI shape instances expose interaction state parameters

patterns.condition: A material instance used as UI fill shows transparent edges
patterns.action: Assign a physical material (typically Wood) to the instance
patterns.statement: Epic notes UI instances need a physical material assigned

patterns.condition: Several materials share the same look with different values
patterns.action: Make one parent material and an instance per variation; parent changes propagate to every child
patterns.statement: Epic's parent and instance model gives reuse

patterns.condition: The same node logic is repeated in several materials
patterns.action: Put it in a material function and expose its parameters in the instance editor
patterns.statement: Epic's material functions package reusable logic

patterns.condition: Instance values must follow player or game data
patterns.action: Bind instance parameters to widget properties through view bindings so they update at runtime
patterns.statement: Epic binds instance parameters to UMG properties

patterns.condition: Complex UI art is built from many textures
patterns.action: Prefer materials; if a texture is needed, one signed distance field texture is lighter and cleaner than several
patterns.statement: Epic calls textures memory intensive and favors SDF textures

patterns.condition: A UI material is asked for soft shadows or detailed art
patterns.action: Know the limits: UI materials give basic shapes, stroke and gradients only; custom SDF shapes cannot soften shadows
patterns.statement: Epic documents the UI material limits

patterns.action: Layer several simple image widgets deliberately to balance look and cost
patterns.statement: Epic suggests layering image widgets strategically
